name: terrain_mesh
doc: Draws a terrain's ground (design/terrain.md) by the hexbound rules (design/import.hexbound.world.md): every top and bottom a 13-point fan whose corners are shared by fused groups and whose midpoints follow the fused or unfused formula, walls as solid minus solid on each half-edge facing the lower side, coloured by material from the biome with the season; water at its levels; collision as convex columns; guides for the sides, openings, flats, roads, rivers, and bridge mounts; and the hull, nature ground, and ground passed on.
